episode_summary: In this episode, D.J. Paris and Tim Littleton discuss the challenges real estate agents face in low inventory markets and how the internet is changing the role of agents. They introduce the Four Doors system, a strategy for finding off-market properties to keep buyers engaged and prevent them from drifting away. By implementing these tactics, agents can increase their value to clients and secure more closings.
